name: 27th Scientific Center of the Russian Ministry of Defense
supervisors: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation

evidence.summary: The US Commerce Department describes the 27th Scientific Center of the Russian Ministry of Defense (27th NTs) as a Russian Government Ministry of Defense facility associated with Russia’s chemical weapons activities, and listed it in March 2021.
It belongs to Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation.

sources.title: Addition of Entities to the Entity List (86 FR 12529, 4 March 2021)
sources.publisher: US Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (Federal Register)
